description: A shell script for initializing and booting a Linux live environment, handling device setup, mounting images, and switching root.

methods.name: udev_daemon
methods.description: Detects available udev daemon executable paths.

methods.name: early_setup
methods.description: Sets up /proc, /sys, /dev, loads kernel modules, and starts udev daemon.

methods.name: read_args
methods.description: Parses kernel command line arguments for boot configuration.

methods.name: boot_live_root
methods.description: Handles device events, mounts filesystems, and switches to the real root filesystem.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Outputs an error message and drops to a shell.
